verdict: ROAS dropped sharply this week; purchases are in a confirmed drought.
narrative: This period, return on ad spend fell 81% week-over-week to 3.54, driven by a steep drop in purchases — down 62.5% in the most recent seven days. A single-day spike of 3 purchases on August 17 sits inside an otherwise flat stretch, so it does not represent a turn. The top campaign — the Muslim Subscription Box — absorbed $850.13 of your $1,501.35 in total spend this period while overall purchase volume remained low, and creative fatigue appears to be compressing reach across the account. Ad creative is being refreshed, and the Live-Cooking Shoot is being prioritised as the next unlock for new content; expect the creative reset to begin moving into market by end of August.
